Add a Russian (`ru` / `Русский`) client locale ([#10](https://github.com/SpookySandwich/dsh-plugin-message-edit/pull/10)).

- Add Russian translations (`I18N.ru`) for all 37 plugin UI and image strings, including `{turn}` and `{count}` placeholder interpolation.
- Register `{ id: 'ru', label: 'Русский', fallback: 'en' }` in the DSH host language catalog (`locale.addLanguage`) when no preloaded Russian language pack already owns `ru`, adding `Русский` to **Settings → General → Language** and cleaning up both catalog and dictionary registrations on plugin disposal.
- Behavior and compatibility notes:
  - Because installing the plugin registers `Русский` (`fallback: 'en'`) in the host-wide language selector, automatic browser-language detection without an explicit stored DSH language preference may select `ru` when Russian appears ahead of Chinese (for example `ru-RU, zh-CN`), causing untranslated host UI to fall back to English rather than Chinese until a language is selected explicitly.
  - A preloaded `ru` / `RU` language pack is respected (`locale.languages()` is checked before calling `locale.addLanguage`); if a separate Russian language pack were loaded *after* this plugin registers `ru`, upstream `locale.addLanguage` would reject the duplicate `ru` registration (no standalone Russian pack is currently known).

新增俄语（`ru` / `Русский`）客户端本地化（完整覆盖全部 37 条界面与图片文案），并在宿主未预加载俄语语言包时向 DSH 语言选择器注册 `Русский`（宿主未翻译界面回退至英语；若未显式保存语言偏好且浏览器语言顺序将俄语排在中文之前，自动检测会选中俄语并将未翻译宿主界面回退为英语；预加载的 `ru` 语言包会被优先保留，若外部 `ru` 语言包在本插件之后加载则会因重复注册 `ru` 被上游拒绝）（[#10](https://github.com/SpookySandwich/dsh-plugin-message-edit/pull/10)）。

Thanks to [@miztizm](https://github.com/miztizm) for contributing the Russian locale in [#10](https://github.com/SpookySandwich/dsh-plugin-message-edit/pull/10).

Validation: 56 automated tests (including 32 client locale and image tests against the published DSH locale runtime and 36 tree assertions), release-tool and npm package checks, and isolated official DSH `0.2.0-rc.2` and `0.2.1-rc.2` fresh-boot, restart, and browser acceptance checks with an offline model. The `v1.4.0` source tag and release are available on GitHub; npm publication of `dsh-plugin-message-edit@1.4.0` is pending manual publish.
